      select 'ngay_ct' as field, @$lockedDate as message
      return
    end
  end
end

Name: CheckKKSapo
Content:
select top 0 * into #ct from kkycct
if not exists(select 1 from @kkycct) 
  insert into #ct select * from kkycct where stt_rec = @stt_rec
else 
  insert into #ct select * from @kkycct  
    
--CheckKKSapo
if(@kk_sapo = 1) begin
	declare @$checkSiteSapo nvarchar(max) = ''
	select distinct a.ma_kho 
		into #siteSapo
		from kkycct a join kkyc b ON a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec
		where b.ngay_ct = @ngay_ct and b.kk_sapo = 1 and b.stt_rec <> @stt_rec and exists(select 1 from #ct z where a.ma_kho = z.ma_kho)

	if exists(select 1 from #siteSapo) begin
		select @$checkSiteSapo = @$checkSiteSapo + case when @$checkSiteSapo <> '' then ', ' else '' end + rtrim(ma_kho)
			from #siteSapo
			order by ma_kho

		select case when @@language = 'v' 
      then N'Mã kho ' + ltrim(rtrim(isnull(@$checkSiteSapo,''))) + N' đã được tạo phiếu yêu cầu kiểm kê Sapo'
      else N'Sites ' + ltrim(rtrim(isnull(@$checkSiteSapo,''))) + ' Sapo inventory request form has been created' end  as message
      return
	end
end
--endCheckKKSapo

Name: CheckSite
Content:
--C--CheckSite YC KHO008
declare @i int, @site_field varchar(32), @xdTable varchar(10), @xmTable varchar(10), @xParti varchar(6), @s nvarchar(4000), @$checkSite nvarchar(max) = ''
  
  select distinct a.ma_kho, IDENTITY(int,1,1) id
    into #site
    from #ct a 
  
  select ma_ct, c$, m$, d$, CAST('' as varchar(32)) site_field, IDENTITY(int,1,1) stt 
	into #VcCheckList
	from dmct9 where ma_ct in('PD1', 'PNH', 'PNI', 'PXH', 'PXI')

	update #VcCheckList set site_field = 'd.ma_kho'
	update #VcCheckList set site_field = 'm.ma_kho' where ma_ct = 'PNI'
	update #VcCheckList set site_field = 'm.ma_khon' where ma_ct = 'PXI'
	
	select top 0 IDENTITY(int,1,1) stt, stt_rec, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_kho
		into #vc
		from wrkin

	select @i = 1, @xParti = convert(varchar(6),@ngay_ct,112)
	while @i is not null begin
		select @site_field = site_field, @xdTable = d$ + ltrim(@xParti), @xmTable = m$ + ltrim(@xParti) from #VcCheckList where stt = @i
		select @s = '
			insert into #vc
				select distinct d.stt_rec, d.ma_ct, d.ngay_ct, d.so_ct, '+@site_field+'
				from '+@xdTable+' d with(nolock) join '+@xmTable+' m on d.stt_rec = m.stt_rec
				where m.status = ''0'' and exists(select 1 from #site s where s.ma_kho = '+@site_field+')'
		exec(@s)
		--print @s
		select @i = MIN(stt) from #VcCheckList where stt > @i
	end
  
  select identity(int,1,1) stt, a.ma_ct, max(b.ten_ct) ten_ct, max(b.ten_ct2) ten_ct2, 
		stuff(
			(	
				select ', ' + ltrim(rtrim(so_ct)) 
					from #vc z 
					where a.ma_ct = z.ma_ct for xml path ('')
			) , 1, 1, ''
		)  as ds_so_ct, cast('' as nvarchar(max)) dien_giai
	into #vcgroup
	from #vc as a join dmct b on a.ma_ct = b.ma_ct
	group by a.ma_ct
  
  if exists(select 1 from #vcgroup) begin
	  update #vcgroup set dien_giai = case when @@language = 'v' then ten_ct else ten_ct2 end + ' (' + ltrim(rtrim(ds_so_ct)) + ')'
	  select @$checkSite = @$checkSite + case when @$checkSite <> '' then '; ' else '' end + dien_giai 
		  from #vcgroup
		  order by stt
      
	  select @$checkSite = rtrim(@$checkSite) + case when @@language = 'v' then N' chưa chuyển trạng thái xuất/ nhập kho.' else ' has not changed the inventory status.' end
    select '' as field, @$checkSite as message
    return
  end
--endCheckSite
